grid.$description: Grid's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--grid-<name>) on the page or a container, and everything inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

gap.$description: The space between cells when gap isn't given (16px).

min-column.$description: The narrowest a column gets with columns="auto" when minColumnWidth isn't given (256px).
